author: NorthEast News Desk
body: One person suffered serious injuries in a collision involving a car and a bicycle in Medway on Tuesday night, authorities said.

Police and emergency crews responded on Milford Street near Clark Street. The injured person was taken to a hospital, according to Boston 25 News. Officials did not immediately release the person’s name, age or current condition.

Milford Street was closed in the area while first responders worked and police began their investigation. The initial report did not identify the driver, describe the direction of travel or say whether any citations or charges were being considered.

Because the available information remains preliminary, the cause of the crash and the sequence leading to impact are not yet established. Road users should avoid drawing conclusions until police release additional findings. The closure was announced as an active-scene measure; drivers should check Medway police updates for the road’s current status. Anyone who witnessed the collision or has relevant video should follow the department’s instructions if investigators request information.
dek: A car-and-bicycle crash Tuesday night sent one person to the hospital and temporarily closed part of Milford Street near Clark Street.
headline: Bicyclist seriously injured in Medway collision
